svg.title: Which positions the twin forward and llama.cpp score
svg.desc: The twin forward scores every position of 2 sequences of 512 tokens from the first 1024; llama.cpp scores positions 256 to 510 of each of 8 chunks of 512, 2040 tokens.
svg.text: HOW TO READ THE NUMBERS · ONE SLICE AT THE DEFAULT SETTINGS
